sfx_types.click_down: mouse button press: short plastic tick, ~8 ms, bright
sfx_types.key_tick: laptop key, 4 variants (field "variant"), +-1.5 dB / +-3% pitch jitter; space bar duller
sfx_types.toggle_clack: switch clack with a tiny slide before it
sfx_types.sticky_slap: paper slap + low felt thump, 60-90 ms; field "gain"
sfx_types.marker_squeak: felt marker on whiteboard; field "dur" = stroke length in s; vary pitch per stroke
sfx_types.paper_whoosh: airy paper swish 0.4-0.6 s, peak at t+0.2
sfx_types.disconnect_thud: muffled low thud + short downward blip (power-off feel)
sfx_types.sync_whoosh: rising airy whoosh with a soft sparkle, 0.4 s
sfx_types.conflict_hit: deep hit: kick + low tom + snare crack, short reverb
sfx_types.alert_chime: dissonant two-bell tail (tritone) under the conflict hit, 1.2 s
sfx_types.resolve_chime: bright major-third two-note chime; variant 1 = higher, softer echo
sfx_types.logo_hit: big warm hit + chime + cymbal swell, 2.5 s ring

music.label: sparse: clock-like ticks, felt piano, a little unease

filter fully open, one-beat breath before the hit
HERO HIT: stop-time on bar 39, then tense minor groove
resolution: lift to major, full groove
warm pads, slower feel, same tempo
